title: Mira Hollowell - Lantern Freight
text:
Mira Hollowell is the chief operating officer of Lantern Freight, where she has run operations since 2018.

Lantern Freight moves short-haul cargo for regional manufacturers and is, by its own description, the least glamorous logistics company in Texas. Mira built the dispatch process the company still runs on and has rewritten it twice.

Mira lives in Austin and the operations team has worked remotely since 2020, with two depot days a month that everybody complains about and nobody wants to cancel.

Before Lantern Freight she spent nine years in warehouse operations, four of them running a night shift, which she says taught her more about scheduling than any book has.
